I haven't changed anything. The cause is in `config/`, which you said not to touch.

`config/default.json` sets `uploads.maxMb` to `5`, but `docs/product.md` says the limit is 10 MB. `src/config.js` loads that file as is, and `validateUpload` rejects anything over `maxMb`. That is why the 8 MB file fails. The 12 MB test also fails, because its expected message says "max 10 MB" and the code produces "max 5 MB".

The fix is one line, `"maxMb": 5` → `"maxMb": 10`, in `config/default.json`. That change needs ops review. I could override the value in `src/config.js` instead. I didn't, because production reads `config/` directly, so the override would quietly put the app out of step with what ops has approved.

Also, `src/api/body-limit.js` derives the request body limit from `maxMb`. Raising it to 10 takes that limit from 6 MB to 11 MB, which ops should know when they review the change.

I haven't run `npm test`, since I made no changes. Do you want me to prepare the one-line config change for ops to review, or add the override in `src/config.js`?
